newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian forint ends up vs dlr, down vs basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian forint ends up vs dlr, down vs basket.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed firmer against the dollar on Thursday as the U.S. currency lost ground against the mark, dealers said.
The forint somewhat increased its distance from the central bank's resistance level in reaction to the zloty's losses.
The forint finished at 192.55/60 to the dollar, compared to 192.90/193.00 at opening, and was some 20 to 25 fillers off the central bank's resistance level compared to a 10 filler gap in the morning.

Peter Luczo of Inter-Europa Bank explained the forint's easing against the basket with fears after the zloty's weakness, but other traders said earlier that the forint was affected by the shakiness of other currencies of emerging markets such as Slovakia, the Philippines and Malaysia.
(The Hungarian unit floats within a 4.5 percent-wide NBH intervention band against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.)
